text: Tools let Claude act; an agent is what you get when Claude uses those tools on its own to finish a whole job.
In a chat, you ask questions and guide every step.
With an agent, you give a goal, and Claude decides the steps, using tools in a loop: think, act, check the result, and repeat until the job is done.
Agents excel at multi-step tasks across multiple files.
For big jobs, Claude can even launch subagents—helpers that work in parallel on fresh desks.
Always give an agent a clear goal, designated files, strict limits, and required check-ins.
